questions.stem: How does the egg cell move along the oviduct towards the uterus?

options.text: Tiny hair-like structures called cilia sweep the egg along
The egg swims using a tail like a sperm cell
Muscular contractions of the ovary push it out

questions.explanation: The oviduct is lined with tiny hair-like cilia that beat in a wave-like motion to sweep the egg along towards the uterus.
